title: Nora, Run!
description: Nora wants to play on top of the statue, but Sister Grace forbids her to...

mainQuestExcel.title: Nora, Run!
mainQuestExcel.description: Nora wants to play on top of the statue, but Sister Grace forbids her to...

dialogs.text: Hmm, what to do...
What's wrong?
See the Anemo Archon statue? Now, look up there, the really high bit... where the archon's hands are.
I wanna go play up there... But Grace won't let me climb the statue.
Please can you go and talk to Grace for a bit? Don't let her look this way. I climb really quickly, I'll be up there in no time...
I guess I can do that...
Yay, thanks!
Go and distract Aunty Grace for a minute, I'll go up right now...
Nora! No!
Phew, I look away for one second and she starts bothering you. I do apologize.
Whyyy! I just wanna play up there for a little bit...
No means no! Your father would not approve either.
And you — please refrain from indulging her! People would be just as worried about you if you did something so dangerous.
It's much too dangerous.
It'll be fine, I'm really good at climbing!
Oh, Nora...
Are you her carer?
Yes, for a number of reasons her mother is... away from home. In the meantime, I'm taking care of her.
I also care for several other children who need someone to look after them. It's part of my duty as a sister.
It's like I suddenly got a whole new family of children. They're good kids, and they get on well with Glory, too.
Timmie's the one I've looked after longest. He's even started calling me Mommy...
Tell me about Nora's father.
Patton is her father. His incessant drinking caused huge problems in the home.
The Church and the Knights of Favonius both gave him a number of warnings, but he would not change his ways. In the end, it was Master Diluc who took action.
Believing that Patton was in no shape to look after Nora, Sister Victoria put her under the care of the Church while Patton takes some time out to reflect.
But when Nora grows up, the excuse we keep giving her that "Daddy is busy with work and needs to be left alone..." It's going to wear thin.
And even the Anemo Archon's dandelions are limited in their reach.
Wah...
What do you want to do up there?

Aunty Grace says that if you want to tell someone a secret, you just need to tell it to a dandelion then throw it to the wind... The Anemo Archon will carry the dandelion seeds and the secret you told it to the person you want.
And the higher you throw it into the wind from, the faster your message will get there...
This one time, Glory got an adventurer to climb up the statue and throw some dandelion seeds into the wind for her. Just a few days later, Godwin wrote her a letter back!
I have a secret to tell Daddy, and I already got a dandelion.
But Aunty Grace won't let me do it. She says that I can go back and live with Daddy when I've grown up.
I wish there was a way to grow up faster... I'm trying as hard as I can, but I'm still so short...
Oh yeah— I always see you gliding around in the city. Can you teach me? How do you do it?
Sure, I'll show you how.
Hee-hee, yay! I'll just stand by and watch, I'm sure I'm allowed to do that.
You wanna glide with me?
No way! Aunty Grace would go mad if she saw me doing that.
You flew there in {ChallengeCurrValue10} minute(s), that's amazing!
Do you wanna go again? I bet you could go even faster...
And I'll give you a prezzie if you do!
Wooow! When I'm bigger, will I be able to glide like that?
For sure!
Woohoo! I'm gonna grow up as fast as possible, then, when Daddy's finished his work, he can play with me!
But maybe it's easier for grown-ups.
Thank you. Here, this is a present for you. It's some treasure that I collected in secret.
Quick, take it... Also, don't tell Aunty Grace!
After you've got your gliding license, sure!
Gliding license? What's that? It sounds complicated...
Hmm, I thought it looked cooler last time... Did you glide the same way?
Wooow! When I'm bigger, will I be able to glide like that?
For sure!
Woohoo! I'm gonna grow up as fast as possible, then, when Daddy's finished his work, he can play with me!
But maybe it's easier for grown-ups.
Thank you. Here, this is a present for you. It's some treasure that I collected in secret.
Quick, take it... Also, don't tell Aunty Grace!
After you've got your gliding license, sure!
Gliding license? What's that? It sounds complicated...
That's enough for today.
Okay... Time to have a rest.
I'll do it again.
Yay! I'll be watching you the whole way.
I'm gonna take a breather...
Don't be too long.
